wholePhysicalScope: The native named and Wikidata-linked museum node sits within the exact 31-vertex building outline at 5 Kiira Road. The address, long gallery arms and octagonal southwest hall are consistent with the museum operator’s and conservation team’s records.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the entrance block, long modernist ranges and roof of the Natural History Gallery. Near levels add louvres, perforated concrete and saw-leaf gallery bays.
limitations: The standing profile represents the historic building documented by the conservation survey before the announced renovation. Final renovation alterations and the cultural village are outside the model.
The concrete louvres, window spacing, shade of exterior finishes, saw-leaf sections, roof junctions and additions are architectural estimates. The original survey’s photos and drawings were excluded.
